tests.title: Jog rotation and touch
tests.why: Check jog function on TRAKTOR KONTROL S4 MK3; avoid assumptions about HID or analog routing.
steps: Consult the exact TRAKTOR KONTROL S4 MK3 manual for the relevant connectors and operating mode.
Exercise each jog element on the device and observe MIDI, HID/software response or audio measurement as applicable.
Check slow and fast transitions, all channels/sides, and repeats; save raw evidence and mark unobservable functions as not tested.
equipment: Compatible host software or capture interface when required

tests.title: Firmware and application compatibility
tests.why: Prevent mismatched firmware and software versions from being reported as hardware failure.
steps: Read installed firmware and hardware revision.
Compare with the model-specific official compatibility and downloads pages.
Record operating system, application version, firmware and documentation URL.

tests.title: Jog Haptic Drive modes and feedback
tests.why: Validate this manufacturer-documented feature using a known-good signal or application.
steps: Open Traktor Pro 3 or later and select JOG mode.
Repeat in motorized TT mode and compare touch/rim response.
Inspect haptic cue ticks, tension and mode indicators.
equipment: Known-good test signal or compatible software

tests.title: Standalone analog mixer mode
tests.why: Validate this manufacturer-documented feature using a known-good signal or application.
steps: Disconnect DJ software as permitted by the official instructions.
Connect known-good supported sources to external input channels.
Verify mixing and output routing without claiming standalone deck playback.
equipment: Known-good test signal or compatible software
